title: A GNN-Based Approach for Code Smell Detection and Refactoring Opportunity Identification
abstract: arXiv:2511.12069v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Code smells indicate latent design or implementation problems that may negatively affect software maintainability. Over the past decades, numerous approaches have been proposed for code smell refactoring, including those based on software metrics, predefined rules, machine learning/deep learning (ML/DL), and, more recently, large language models (LLMs). However, traditional metric- and rule-based approaches rely heavily on manually defined criteria, while ML/DL approaches are often constrained by the availability of training data and the design of model architectures. Although LLMs provide advanced code understanding capabilities, they typically incur substantial computational and time costs, particularly when applied to large-scale software systems. translated_title: 一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的代码坏味检测与重构机会识别方法
translated_abstract: 代码坏味（Code Smells）指示了潜在的设计或实现问题，可能会对软件的可维护性产生负面影响。在过去几十年中，已有大量针对代码坏味重构的方法被提出，包括基于软件度量、预定义规则、机器学习/深度学习（ML/DL）以及近期基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法。然而，传统的基于度量和规则的方法严重依赖人工定义的标准，而机器学习/深度学习方法往往受限于训练数据的可获得性和模型架构的设计。尽管大语言模型提供了先进的代码理解能力，但它们通常会产生高昂的计算和时间成本，尤其是在应用于大规模软件系统时。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于图的深度学习方法用于代码坏味重构。具体而言，我们在类级别和方法级别构建代码图，并采用图……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于图神经网络的深度学习方法，通过在类级别和方法级别构建代码图来检测代码坏味并识别重构机会，从而克服了传统方法依赖人工规则、机器学习方法训练数据受限以及大语言模型计算成本过高的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a graph neural network-based deep learning approach that constructs code graphs at both class and method levels to detect code smells and identify refactoring opportunities, overcoming the limitations of manually defined criteria, constrained ML/DL training data, and the high computational costs of LLMs.
